instruction: Compare MacBook Air M2 with MacBook Air M1 and iMac 24-inch

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing Mac models (MacBook Air and iMac) using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the Mac comparison page and select the three specified models: MacBook Air M2, MacBook Air M1, and iMac 24-inch. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for Mac models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify the instruction requirements
Getter logic: get_active_tab_url_parse correctly extracts modelList from URL query parameters with split_list=true, converting comma-separated values into a list

Metric logic: check_direct_json_object correctly handles the ignore_list_order flag. When expected.type='rule', get_rule returns rules dict, so expected_json = rules['expected'] = {'modelList': [...], 'ignore_list_order': true}. The check at line 428 'expected_json.get("ignore_list_order", False)' correctly finds the flag at the right level
The ignore_list_order logic at lines 429-434 correctly sorts both lists before comparison, allowing models to be selected in any order
Expected model IDs are semantically correct and match Apple's URL parameter format (macbook-air-m2, macbook-air-m1, imac-24)
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks all three models required by the instruction
The evaluator will correctly pass when models are selected in any order, which matches the expected user interaction pattern on Apple's comparison page
